newsitem.title: USA: North Coast Energy sets Dutch investment.
newsitem.headline: North Coast Energy sets Dutch investment.

text.p: North Coast Energy Inc said Monday Nuon International bv has agreed to invest up to $15 million in North Coast over three years.
The two companies will form an alliance to develop a wide range of energy services and products, North Coast said.
It said the Nuon NV subsidiary will purchase about 5.7 million North Coast common shares for $5 million at a closing scheduled for September 4.

Subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions, including the development of a plan of complementary business, Nuon will purchase an additional 5.7 million North Coast shares for $5 million by each of September 1998 and September 1999, the company said.
If Nuon acquires these additional shares, it will become the majority stockholder of North Coast, the company pointed out. It now has about 10.8 million shares outstanding.

This transaction is subject to customary conditions and governmental approvals, including the approval of Nuon's supervisory board. Upon the closing of the transaction, Nuon will appoint three North Coast directors.
